_about: Lånekassen (Norwegian State Educational Loan Fund) rules for a full-time university degree student in the Nordic region, calendar year 2026. Calendar year 2026 spans school years 2025-2026 (January to June) and 2026-2027 (August to December).

basicSupportPerMonth2025_2026.appliesTo: School year 2025-2026 (January to June 2026). Paid out as basic loan (basislån).
basicSupportPerMonth2025_2026.sourceTitle: Forskrift om endring i forskrift om utdanningsstøtte (2025-2026), § 74

basicSupportPerMonth2026_2027.appliesTo: School year 2026-2027 (August to December 2026). Paid out as basic loan (basislån).

monthsPerSchoolYear.appliesTo: University students with a full-time spring semester. July is not paid.
monthsPerSchoolYear.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 72 Periode med lån og stipend i studieåret

conversionShareCredits.appliesTo: Converted to grant for passed credits. Only for students not living with their parents. Students abroad must submit their results themselves.
conversionShareCredits.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 77 Omgjøring på grunnlag av beståtte studiepoeng

conversionShareDegree.appliesTo: Converted to grant when the degree is completed. Students abroad get it after submitting the diploma.
conversionShareDegree.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 78 Omgjøring på grunnlag av bestått grad

incomeLimit.appliesTo: Gross personal and capital income in the calendar year, when support is received for more than 7 months of the year.
incomeLimit.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 98 Behovsprøving mot person- og kapitalinntekt

incomeLimitShortSupport.appliesTo: Income limit when support is received for 7 months or less of the calendar year.
incomeLimitShortSupport.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 98 Behovsprøving mot person- og kapitalinntekt

shortSupportMaxMonths.appliesTo: The higher income limit applies with this many support months or fewer.
shortSupportMaxMonths.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 98 Behovsprøving mot person- og kapitalinntekt

grantReductionPerMonth.unit: share of income above limit, per support month
grantReductionPerMonth.appliesTo: The grant is reduced by 5 % of the income above the limit for each month with support. The grant cannot go below zero.
grantReductionPerMonth.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 98 Behovsprøving mot person- og kapitalinntekt

wealthLimit.appliesTo: Not used in calculations. Shown as a note: wealth above this also reduces the grant.
wealthLimit.sourceTitle: Forskrift om utdanningsstøtte, § 100 Behovsprøving mot formue

payoutAbroad.appliesTo: Students abroad are paid once per semester, the whole semester at once, normally in June or July and in December. Students in Norway are paid monthly around the 15th.

nordicSupportExcluded.appliesTo: No Lånekassen support in months with living support from another Nordic country (SU, CSN). Those periods count against the maximum support time.
nordicSupportExcluded.sourceTitle: Lånekassen: Universitet og høgskole i Norden

dkkToNok2025.appliesTo: Norges Bank annual average 2025 (157.00 NOK per 100 DKK). Default until the 2026 average is published. Users can override it.
dkkToNok2025.sourceTitle: Norges Bank: Exchange rates, annual average (Average of observations through period)
